_comment: Credential-free description of the broker topology this stack expects.
This file is the auditable reference for what entrypoint.sh creates at
runtime. It is intentionally NOT imported with `rabbitmqctl import_definitions`:
a definitions file must embed a password hash, and that would put a
credential in version control, which the audit explicitly forbids.
Credentials come from RABBITMQ_USER / RABBITMQ_PASSWORD in the environment
(compose `.env`, or a k8s secretKeyRef) and are applied by entrypoint.sh,
which verifies them with `rabbitmqctl authenticate_user` before writing the
REPLACE_ME_* values below are placeholders, not secrets.

vhosts.description: Default vhost used by the gateway publisher and the billing consumer
